repo.name: Monkeytype Key Sounds
repo.description: Monkeytype's key sounds as WM Keyboard sound packs — every recording of each set, picked at random per keystroke, the way monkeytype plays them.
repo.author: Wasi Master

addons.name: Click
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Monkeytype's default: a dry, very short interface click with no body under it. The quietest thing in the pack and the easiest to type on for hours.

addons.name: Beep
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A short digital beep — a pitched tone rather than a physical impact. Cuts through a noisy room where the click disappears.

addons.name: Pop
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A soft bubble pop: a low blip with a quick downward bend and almost no attack. Rounded where Click is dry.

addons.name: NK Creams
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Novelkeys Cream linears: the deep, hollow POM sound those switches are bought for. Six recordings, so the same key never sounds identical twice, each with its own key-up thock.

addons.name: Typewriter
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A real typebar striking the platen, with the carriage rattle left in. Six recordings — the variation is most of the effect — and the typebar falling back is its own sound on key-up.

addons.name: Osu
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: The hitsound from osu!: a bright, percussive tap with a metallic edge. Reads as a score rather than a keystroke.

addons.name: Hitmarker
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: The shooter hitmarker tick — a tight, high, unmistakably digital confirmation. Every letter is a headshot.

addons.name: Fist Fight
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Body-blow impacts from a fight scene, eight of them. Typing a paragraph sounds like losing one.

addons.name: Rubber Keys
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A rubber-dome membrane board: dull, short and almost entirely without a click. The closest thing here to a laptop keyboard.

addons.name: Fart
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Eight of them. There is no defending this one; monkeytype ships it, so it is here.

addons.name: Akko Lavenders
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Akko Lavender linears: smooth, mid-pitched and even, with none of the tick a tactile leaves behind. Ten recordings, and a key-up for every one of them.

addons.name: CherryMX Black ABS
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Cherry MX Black linears under ABS keycaps — heavier and blunter than the PBT cut, with more plastic ring on top. Nine recordings, each with the stem returning as a separate key-up sound.

addons.name: CherryMX Black PBT
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Cherry MX Black linears under PBT keycaps: the same switch as the ABS set, drier and a touch lower. Ten recordings, each split into the press and the return.

addons.name: CherryMX Blue ABS
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Cherry MX Blue clickies under ABS keycaps — the click jacket's sharp double tick, the sound most people picture when they hear "mechanical keyboard". Ten recordings, and the second tick lands when you lift, not on a timer.

addons.name: CherryMX Blue PBT
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Cherry MX Blue clickies under PBT keycaps: the same click with a denser, less hollow tail. Nine recordings, and the click bar ticks again on the way up.

addons.name: CherryMX Brown PBT
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Cherry MX Brown tactiles under PBT keycaps — a small bump and a quiet, restrained sound. The office-safe Cherry. Nine recordings, with a soft key-up to match.

addons.name: Kalih Box White
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Kailh Box White clickies: a click bar rather than a jacket, so the tick is higher, tighter and repeats identically on release — which here really is on release. Ten recordings. (Upstream spells it "Kalih"; kept as published.)

addons.name: Razer Green
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Razer Greens: a loud, bright, deliberately gamer-facing click with more high end than the Cherry Blues. Nine recordings, and the loudest key-up in the catalogue.

addons.name: Tealios V2
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Tealios V2 linears: the smooth, glassy, slightly high-pitched sound that made them the enthusiast default. Seven recordings, each cut into the press and the stem coming back up.

addons.name: Trust GXT
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A Trust GXT budget mechanical board — rattly, hollow and cheerfully unrefined. Seven recordings, and it rattles on the way up as much as on the way down.

addons.name: Error: Damage
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: Monkeytype's "damage" mistype sound: a short, dull hit. Meant for a wrong keystroke, so it is unforgiving as a key sound — which is the point if you want one.

addons.name: Error: Triangle
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A falling triangle-wave tone. Pitched rather than percussive, so it reads as a buzzer more than an impact.

addons.name: Error: Square
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A falling square-wave tone: the same shape as the triangle error with the harsh 8-bit edge left on.

addons.name: Error: Missed Punch
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: A punch thrown and missed — a whoosh with no impact at the end. Two recordings.

addons.name: Fart Reverb
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: The single reverb-tailed one monkeytype keeps outside the click sets. Long for a key sound; try it on the spacebar role only.

addons.name: Time Warning
addons.author: Monkeytype contributors
addons.description: The chime monkeytype plays as a timed test runs out. A clean bell rather than a click — pleasant on the enter key.
